name: polydev
description: Ask several other AI models the same question and compare their answers.

interface.shortDescription: Second opinions from other AI models
interface.longDescription: Polydev sends your question to the AI models you set up in your Polydev account, such as Gemini, Grok and Claude, and returns each answer so you can compare them. It can also search recent public posts on X. Polydev only reads and answers; it does not change anything in other services.
defaultPrompt: Ask other models why this bug happens.
Compare what other models say about this design.
Get a second opinion on this code review.

positive.prompt: My React effect runs in an infinite loop when I pass an options object as a dependency. Ask other models why and how to fix it.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns answers from the models set up in the account; ChatGPT summarises where they agree (the object is recreated each render) and the fix (useMemo or a primitive dependency).

positive.prompt: Ask Polydev whether I should store sessions in Redis or Postgres for a 10k-user app, and compare the answers.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns several models' answers with trade-offs; ChatGPT compares them and gives a recommendation.

positive.prompt: Get other models to review this function for security issues: def login(u,p): return db.execute(f"SELECT * FROM users WHERE name='{u}' AND pw='{p}'")
positive.expected_behavior: Models flag SQL injection and plaintext passwords; ChatGPT lists the shared findings and a parameterised-query fix.

positive.prompt: Use Polydev to search X for what people are saying about the latest Node.js LTS release.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns recent public posts with authors and links; ChatGPT summarises the themes. Read-only.

positive.prompt: Of the answers you just got from Polydev, the Gemini one was most useful. Record that.
positive.expected_behavior: Records the ranking for the previous comparison and confirms it was saved.

negative.prompt: Use Polydev to generate a logo image for my startup.
negative.expected_behavior: Polydev's connector has no image tool; ChatGPT says so and does not call a tool.

negative.prompt: Use Polydev to send this summary to my team on Slack.
negative.expected_behavior: Polydev only asks models and searches X; ChatGPT explains it can't send messages and does not call a tool.

negative.prompt: Ask Polydev to check whether this AWS secret key is valid: AKIA... / wJalr...
negative.expected_behavior: ChatGPT declines to send credentials to other model providers and suggests rotating the key; no tool call.

review.commerce_description: Polydev does not sell products or process payments in ChatGPT.

publication.release_notes: First release: ask other AI models, compare answers, search X.
